title: PCG vows no water cannon retaliation amid China pressure
detail: Year-opening review cited repeated 2025 China Coast Guard water cannon attacks and research vessel intrusions; PCG said it would not use water cannon to avoid escalation.
attribution: PCG Commodore Jay Tarriela via Philstar

title: Motorbanca capsizes in Davao Gulf; 5 bodies found, 10 missing
detail: PCG Southeastern Mindanao said a recreational boat with 16 aboard capsized off Sarangani, Davao Occidental; 1 rescued.

title: Ambush kills 4 soldiers in Munai
detail: Authorities said Dawlah Islamiya-Maute members ambushed troops in Barangay Lininding, killing four soldiers (reported in April follow-up).

title: Ro-ro ferry sinks off Basilan, 18 dead
detail: M/V Trisha Kirstin 3 (Zamboanga-Jolo) with 332 aboard sank near Baluk-Baluk Island; over 200 rescued, 18 reported dead initially.
attribution: PCG and local officials via PNA

title: Off-duty soldier shot dead in Pagayawan
detail: An off-duty 55th IB corporal was shot dead on his motorcycle by gunmen suspected to be Dawlah Islamiya remnants.

title: Catanduanes floods: 1 dead, Bato River overflows
detail: Shear-line rains flooded several towns; a man was swept away in Virac and the provincial government ordered mandatory evacuation.
place: Bato, Virac, San Miguel, Viga, Bagamanoc

title: 24 Filipinos forced into Cambodia scam work repatriated
detail: BI said 24 Filipinos forced to run romance-crypto and fake casino scams in Cambodia returned via Phnom Penh flight.
attribution: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony Viado via Philstar

title: AMLC: 53% of suspicious inbound remittances tied to child exploitation
detail: AMLC threat assessment found 155,600 suspicious inbound remittances (PHP3.42 billion) in 2021-mid 2024, 53% by volume linked to child exploitation.

title: Kanlaon Volcano explosive eruption
detail: PHIVOLCS reported a 2-minute eruption with 2,000 m plume and pyroclastic currents on upper slopes; Alert Level 2 kept, 4-km danger zone.

title: Shear-line floods force evacuation in Bislig
detail: Bislig CDRRMO evacuated 2,054 people from 19 barangays due to shear-line flooding.

title: PHP6.6B shabu lab in Valenzuela warehouse
detail: PDEA seized about 906 kg shabu and 64 L liquid meth worth PHP6.6 billion in a Valenzuela warehouse; no arrests on site, suspects identified.

title: 12 Koreans arrested at suspected Angeles scam hub
detail: BI raided a suspected scam office on Poinsettia Street, arresting 12 Korean nationals incl. 3 fugitives; setup appeared to target Korean victims.

title: Rabies cases down 65% in early 2026
detail: DOH reported 17 rabies cases from Jan 4 to Feb 21, 2026, against 49 a year earlier; it said 13 were caused by unvaccinated animals. Health Secretary Ted Herbosa warned mortality is almost 100% once symptoms start.

title: 800 kg marijuana from Thailand seized at Manila port
detail: Customs and anti-narcotics agents seized 800 kg of marijuana worth PHP1.2 billion at Manila International Container Port; a broker representative held. Separately PDEA seized 20.5 kg shabu in Quezon City.
attribution: BOC Commissioner Ariel Nepomuceno via Philstar

title: Chinese vessels drive Filipino fishers from Scarborough
detail: Filipino fishermen reported being driven from Scarborough Shoal by Chinese vessels; the PCG flew a maritime domain awareness flight and reported its aircraft was challenged by Chinese ships.
attribution: PCG and fishermen via Daily Tribune

title: CIDG raids 24/7 e-sabong hub in Tondo, 172 held
detail: CIDG-NCR raided an illegal online cockfighting operation at a Tondo coliseum; 172 held (40 staff detained); police estimated about PHP300,000 in bets per fight.

title: Army officer killed in Occidental Mindoro NPA clash
detail: Army's 203rd IB said an officer was killed and 2 soldiers wounded in a 20-minute clash with about 15 NPA members; one rebel arrested.

title: Measles-rubella cases up 45% in Q1
detail: DOH reported 1,627 measles-rubella cases from Jan 4 to Mar 21, 2026 (vs 1,121 a year earlier), about 68% unvaccinated, and one measles death in Quezon City. BARMM (344) and Soccsksargen (322) led regions.

title: Flares fired near PCG plane over Mischief Reef
detail: PCG said at least 3 flares were fired from Chinese-occupied features as its civilian plane passed within 3 nm of Mischief Reef, hours after activating a Coast Guard District at Pag-asa Island.

title: 10 Dawlah Islamiya-Maute members killed in Marantao
detail: Police and Army said 10 DI-Maute members incl. leader were killed while serving warrants; authorities linked them to the 23 Jan Munai ambush that killed 4 soldiers.

title: Two Japanese fugitives arrested in Metro Manila
detail: PAOCC, BI and PNP arrested two Japanese fugitives linked to the Luffy group and JP Dragon syndicate in Mandaluyong and Manila for deportation.

title: NBI raids Paranaque love-scam hub, 48 arrested
detail: NBI Special Action Unit arrested 41 Filipino women and 7 foreigners running romance, pig-butchering and crypto scams from a condominium.

title: 19 NPA rebels killed in Toboso clash
detail: Army's 79th IB said 19 suspected NPA members of the Northern Negros Front were killed in clashes starting 18-19 April; about 366 residents displaced.

title: Balikatan 2026 exercise: 17,000 troops from 7 countries
detail: AFP said Balikatan would run 20 April to 8 May with over 17,000 troops from the Philippines, US, Australia, Japan, Canada, France and New Zealand; Japan to fire Type 88 missile in live fire.

title: Bus plunges into ravine in Pagbilao, 2 dead, 37 hurt
detail: A Daet-Manila bus reportedly lost control after engine trouble on the diversion road and fell into a ravine.

title: Pre-dawn house fire kills 6 in Urdaneta
detail: A fire that started around 02:00 in the kitchen of one of two houses in Barangay Nancayasan killed six people, including two minors and an elderly person, and destroyed both homes.

title: Freeze order on sitting lawmaker's assets in flood-control probe
detail: AMLC said the Court of Appeals froze bank accounts, insurance policies and property of an unnamed sitting legislator, an associate and a corporation over alleged ghost flood-control projects.

title: 2 NPA rebels killed in Motiong, Samar clash
detail: Army's 8th ID said two rebels were killed and left by comrades in Barangay Caulayanan; weapons recovered; earlier clashes 16-17 April in Jiabong.

title: PAGASA: danger-level heat index in 7 areas
detail: PAGASA forecast danger-level heat indices of 42-43C on April 30 in seven areas, highest at Sangley Point (Cavite City) and Aborlan (Palawan), and advised precautions against heat stress.

title: Kaliwet Bailey detour bridge collapses under overloaded truck
detail: DPWH said a 20-ton truck exceeding the 5-ton limit collapsed the detour bridge; temporary bridge deployed.

title: Shellfish ban extended to Daram, Samar waters
detail: BFAR said lab tests confirmed toxic red tide in Daram's coastal waters, adding it to shellfish bans in Matarinao Bay (Eastern Samar), Dumanquilas Bay, Bolinao and Anda (Pangasinan) and Tantangan Bay. Gathering, selling and eating shellfish and alamang from these waters is prohibited.
agency: Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources

title: Red alert and rotating brownouts on Luzon, Visayas grids
detail: NGCP raised red alerts after two 500-kV lines to Ilijan tripped; Luzon short 413 MW; rotating brownouts hit 200,000+ customers in Metro Manila and nearby provinces.

title: 25 trafficked from Myanmar KK Park scam hub return; recruiter held
detail: NBI said 25 Filipinos trafficked to KK Park in Myawaddy, Myanmar, where they were coerced into online fraud, were repatriated via NAIA; a female recruiter who offered PHP50,000-a-month jobs via Telegram and WhatsApp was arrested and charged under the Anti-Trafficking law.

title: 5 NPA remnants killed in Cauayan encounter
detail: Army's 15th IB said 5 NPA members were killed in three gunbattles; M60 and rifles recovered; about 180 families evacuated.

title: Danger-level heat index in 44 areas, up to 44C
detail: PAGASA forecast danger-level heat index in 44 areas, peaking at 44C in 8 stations incl. Munoz, Sangley Point and Butuan.

title: 63 arrested in Pasig online investment scam raid
detail: PNP-ACG with DOJ, PAOCC and SEC raided an online investment scam using a fake trading platform in Barangay San Antonio.

title: PHP136M shabu seized in Naga City, Cebu buy-bust
detail: PDEA-7 with PCG, Navy and PNP seized 20 packs of shabu worth PHP136 million and arrested two.

title: Damaged Maynilad pipe cuts water in Manila and Cavite
detail: A 750-mm Maynilad line in Ermita was damaged by a city contractor, interrupting supply in Manila, Paranaque, Las Pinas, Pasay and several Cavite towns.

title: Two buses and SUV collide on Marcos Highway, 1 dead, 90+ hurt
detail: A bus that lost its brakes hit another bus and an SUV in Tuba, Benguet; LTFRB suspended 26 buses of the operator.

title: NBI raids abusive collection agency in Quezon City
detail: NBI arrested 26 people at an unlicensed collection firm whose staff allegedly impersonated officials to coerce debtors into paying again; NBI estimated commissions of about PHP36 million a month.

title: PAGASA declares rainy season onset
detail: PAGASA declared the rainy season over western Luzon and Visayas, noting looming El Nino could enhance habagat rains in the west.

title: M7.8 offshore Sarangani earthquake with tsunami
detail: PHIVOLCS: Mw 7.8, depth 33 km, 32 km W of Maasim; Intensity VII in General Santos; ~1 m tsunami at Kiamba and Maasim.

title: Quake knocks out power to ~864,000 Mindanao households
detail: After the M7.8 quake, about 864,000 households in South Cotabato, Sarangani, Sultan Kudarat and Davao lost power; DOE activated its energy resiliency task force.
place: South Cotabato, Sarangani, Sultan Kudarat, Davao

title: General Santos airport shut after quake
detail: CAAP suspended operations at General Santos International Airport via NOTAM 08:45-15:00 for facility assessment.

title: 22 trafficking victims return from Cambodia
detail: DMW said 22 Filipinos rescued from human trafficking in Cambodia arrived at NAIA Terminal 1 from Phnom Penh.

title: PDEA May 2026 tally: PHP1.95B drugs, 3,702 arrests
detail: PDEA reported PHP1.95 billion in drugs seized and 3,702 arrested in 2,941 May operations, incl. 5 elected officials.

title: BI raids suspected love-scam hub in Paranaque condo
detail: Bureau of Immigration agents arrested five foreign nationals (Chinese, Malaysian and Burmese) at a condominium complex in Paranaque linked to a crypto love-scam operation where workers were reportedly restricted from leaving; they face deportation proceedings.

title: AMLC risk assessment rates tax crimes a high ML threat
detail: AMLC's third National Risk Assessment said tax evasion proceeds move via shell companies, false invoicing and real estate; drug-related STRs 2021-2024 totalled PHP25.09 billion.

title: DOH: 44 mpox cases in 2026, no outbreak
detail: DOH reported 44 mpox cases from Jan 4 to Jun 13, 2026, 79% below the same period of 2025; spokesperson Albert Domingo said there was no outbreak or increase.

title: Sarangani quake toll reaches 88 dead
detail: NDRRMC reported 88 dead (9 confirmed), 1,316 injured, 24 missing, 1.68 million people affected and 113,279 houses damaged across Regions 9, 11, 12 and BARMM.

title: Iloilo confirms first ASF case of 2026
detail: The Iloilo provincial veterinarian reported African swine fever in a sow and four pigs at a backyard farm in Barotac Viejo; the office said the animals were disposed of, the site disinfected and checkpoints tightened, with no suspected cases in the surrounding community.

title: Kanlaon eruption sends ash to Negros and Cebu
detail: PHIVOLCS reported a 3-minute moderately explosive eruption with 2-3 km plume; ashfall in Canlaon, San Carlos and parts of Cebu; Alert Level 2.

title: Pangasinan tightens poultry checks after bird flu
detail: Avian influenza cases confirmed in June in two Pangasinan towns prompted a ban on live poultry from affected areas and stricter checkpoint inspections requiring veterinary health certificates, according to local officials and the Bureau of Animal Industry.
agency: Bureau of Animal Industry / Pangasinan LGUs
attribution: Local officials via GMA Regional TV

title: DOH-7 warns of Kanlaon ashfall risks in Cebu
detail: DOH Central Visayas Director Joshua Brillantes warned that ash from Kanlaon Volcano reaching Cebu, notably Toledo, could cause respiratory, skin and eye problems; EMB-7 detected elevated PM10. Residents were urged to stay indoors and wear N95/KN95 masks.

title: H5N1 bird flu in Oriental Mindoro backyard flock
detail: WOAH, citing Philippine authorities, reported an H5N1 outbreak in a backyard flock of 39 birds in Oriental Mindoro (town reported as 'Capalan'); all birds were culled.
agency: World Organisation for Animal Health (citing PH authorities)
attribution: WOAH report via Reuters/The Poultry Site

title: Typhoon Inday and enhanced monsoon: 20 reported dead
detail: NDRRMC reported 20 dead (1 validated), 9 injured and 16 missing from Typhoon Inday and the enhanced southwest monsoon; about 654,000 people affected and infrastructure damage estimated at PHP3.18 billion.
place: Mindanao and Visayas (Sarangani, Lanao del Sur, Bukidnon, Iloilo, Davao Occidental, Quezon)

title: AMLC seeks power to freeze assets without court order
detail: AMLC asked Congress for authority to suspend transactions and initially freeze assets without a CA order and to cover virtual asset providers and trusts, ahead of 2027 FATF evaluation.
attribution: AMLC Executive Director Ronel Buenaventura via Philstar

title: Navy sailor struck with baton near Ayungin Shoal
detail: AFP said a China Coast Guard member hit a Philippine Navy sailor on the head with a baton near BRP Sierra Madre at Ayungin (Second Thomas) Shoal, also damaging a Philippine boat.
attribution: AFP, NSC and DND via Philstar

title: China Coast Guard water cannon at Scarborough Shoal (two days)
detail: PCG said China Coast Guard vessels fired water cannon at Philippine government vessels near Scarborough Shoal on 23 and 24 July, hitting two ships; China's foreign ministry called its actions lawful.
attribution: PCG spokesperson Jay Tarriela via Al Jazeera

title: TD Kiyapo prompts Signal No. 1 in northern Luzon
detail: PAGASA raised Signal No. 1 over Batanes, Cagayan, Isabela and other northern Luzon areas; Kiyapo forecast to near or hit Babuyan/Cagayan.

title: Angat Dam hits lowest recorded level
detail: Angat Dam fell to 150.55 m, prompting MWSS to cut raw water allocation to Bulacan water districts.

title: 2 NPA killed, 1 captured in Oriental Mindoro
detail: Daily Tribune reported 2 NPA members killed and 1 captured in a clash in Oriental Mindoro (details limited).

title: Maymay rains trigger deadly landslides in Benguet and Rizal
detail: Reports said a hillside collapsed on a Benguet eatery killing two workers, and a landslide in Rizal killed two, amid TD Maymay (Kujira) rains.
attribution: Police and disaster agency via Philstar

title: Drilling-capable Chinese survey ship 25 days in PH EEZ
detail: PCG spokesperson Jay Tarriela said the Chinese survey ship Haiyang Dizhi Shihao operated in the Philippine EEZ from Aug 10 to Sept 4, including three weeks within Scarborough Shoal's territorial sea, without a DFA research permit and periodically with AIS off.

title: BARMM interim Chief Minister survives ambush
detail: Unidentified gunmen fired on the convoy of interim BARMM Chief Minister Abdulraof Macacua; no casualties, vehicles damaged, ahead of 14 Sept elections.

title: Three gun attacks in BARMM kill 3
detail: Police reported three motorcycle-borne gun attacks on 21-22 Aug in Datu Odin Sinsuat, Pikit/Pagalungan area and Sultan Kudarat killing two women and a police-station civilian staffer; 2 wounded.
place: Datu Odin Sinsuat; Pikit/Pagalungan; Sultan Kudarat

title: Pasay residential fire kills family of 4
detail: A second-alarm fire on Tengco Street, Barangay 107, killed four members of one family trapped when their house collapsed, injured at least four and affected about 30 families, per BFP and barangay officials.
attribution: BFP and barangay officials via Philstar

title: Red tide warning for Leyte, Leyte shellfish
detail: BFAR issued a precautionary shellfish warning for coastal waters of Leyte town after samples tested positive for paralytic shellfish toxin, pending confirmation; bans also remained in Matarinao Bay and Biliran Island waters.
agency: Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources

title: Motorbanca capsizes on Lake Mapanuepe, 6 Aeta dead
detail: PCG said a boat carrying 13 Aeta residents capsized in strong winds; 6 dead incl. 3 minors, 3 missing, 4 rescued.

title: Tarlac bridges collapse in monsoon floods; 4 missing
detail: DPWH said river currents washed out a pier of Agana Bridge after Aquino Bridge partly collapsed on 28 Aug; a vehicle fell in, 4 missing, 1 rescued; province declared state of calamity.
attribution: DPWH Secretary Vince Dizon via Philstar

title: Monsoon backflood inundates 71 Bulacan villages
detail: Bulacan PDRRMO said floods up to five feet hit Calumpit; 71 villages in six towns flooded, 5,511 people in evacuation centres.

title: OCD: August floods and landslides kill over 30 in Luzon
detail: OCD said monsoon rains enhanced by Luis, Maymay, Neneng and Obet killed 30+, incl. 15 in Benguet mostly from landslides; about 8 million affected.

title: Storms Maymay, Luis, Neneng and habagat: 33 dead, 8.6M affected
detail: NDRRMC figures reported 33 dead, 19 injured and 3 missing, with 8.6 million people affected across Luzon, Visayas and Western Mindanao; infrastructure damage PHP6.12 billion and farm losses PHP2.32 billion; 117 LGUs under state of calamity.

title: DOH issues air quality guidance amid haze
detail: DOH issued an air quality index guide and advised masks and limited outdoor activity as haze, linked to Indonesian fires, reportedly pushed readings to 'very unhealthy' in parts of Bicol and Zamboanga Peninsula; Metro Manila stayed fair to good, per DENR-EMB and UP IESM data cited.

title: Leptospirosis: 6,253 cases, 378 deaths; post-flood surge warned
detail: DOH reported 6,253 leptospirosis cases and 378 deaths (CFR 6.05%) from Jan 4 to Aug 29, 2026, and warned of a post-flood surge; several Quezon City and Manila hospitals were near full capacity. Quezon City logged 437 cases and 30 deaths, 296 cases in August alone.

title: PLA flares fired at PCG aircraft over Kalayaan Island Group
detail: PCG said flares were fired from Zamora (Subi) and Panganiban (Mischief) reefs at an unarmed PCG maritime domain awareness flight.
attribution: PCG spokesperson Rear Adm. Jay Tarriela via PNA

title: MV June Aster ferry fire off Coron: 77 dead
detail: PCG said the Manila-Coron ferry caught fire off Coron; toll reached 77 dead, 12 missing, 43 rescued by 16 Sept; cause under investigation.

title: Two police among 5 held in PNPA recruitment extortion
detail: CIDG arrested five, including two police officers, for demanding PHP250,000 (later PHP150,000) from a police academy applicant.

title: Election-day gun violence in Cotabato City
detail: Philstar reported gun violence before polls opened in Cotabato City left 3 dead and 15 wounded during the first BARMM parliamentary elections; Comelec called incidents isolated.

title: 8 Metro Manila DOH hospitals full for leptospirosis
detail: DOH said eight Metro Manila hospitals including East Avenue Medical Center, Quirino Memorial and Tondo Medical Center had filled their leptospirosis bed capacity, with San Lazaro Hospital holding 86 cases; 128 beds remained in 12 other DOH hospitals. It cited 8,317 infections nationwide in 2026.

title: China Coast Guard rams BFAR vessel off Palawan
detail: PCG said China Coast Guard cutter 21585 deliberately rammed BFAR vessel Magat Salamat about 54 nm off Palawan on a mission to support a grounded vessel near Half Moon Shoal, damaging railings; China's coast guard blamed the Philippine side.
place: Off Palawan (about 54 nm), West Philippine Sea
attribution: PCG and China Coast Guard statements via USNI News

title: 1-2 cyclones a month expected Oct-Dec
detail: PAGASA expects one to two tropical cyclones per month in Q4 2026, mostly landfalling or crossing, amid strong El Nino.

title: Leptospirosis up 38%, dengue down 33%
detail: DOH reported 10,936 suspected leptospirosis cases as of Sept 16 (up 38% year on year), driven by typhoon and monsoon floods, with NCR, Cagayan Valley and Calabarzon most affected. Dengue cases fell 33% to 155,918 from Jan 4 to Sept 16.

title: AMLC: PHP24.7B frozen, mostly flood-control corruption
detail: AMLC reported PHP24.7 billion in assets frozen; 14 flood-control cases cover about PHP20.2 billion, and 18 of 28 civil forfeiture petitions in Jan-Jun 2026 were corruption-linked (PHP15.7 billion).

title: Report estimates PHP603B yearly exposure to mule-driven fraud
detail: A private-sector report (IDfy Philippines and CIBI) estimated PHP603 billion a year at risk from mule-account fraud; NBI cited mule accounts selling for PHP500-5,000 each.
attribution: IDfy Philippines and CIBI report via Philstar

title: PAGASA: very strong El Nino from October
detail: PAGASA forecast a very strong El Nino from October 2026 with below to way-below-normal rain in Luzon, Visayas, Caraga; about 45 provinces already had rainfall deficits.
